title: Woodland Nesting

outfit_card.silhouette: Floor-length empire-waist gown with a fitted bodice, flowing A-line skirt, and a draped back panel that suggests soft wing-like volume without constructing a full cape.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Slender gold vine crown with tiny white blossoms and leaf-shaped hairpins nestled into the hair.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Halter-style bodice with a halter neckline, sheer mint organza overlay, pearl and gold vine embroidery, small fabric rosettes at the bust, and detached arm bands connected by fine gold chains.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Layered skirt of pale mint chiffon over a white lace-trimmed petticoat, delicate vine embroidery at the hem, and matching pale heeled sandals with ankle ribbons.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Feather-shaped hair ornaments, tiny bird and nest motifs, floating leaf and feather accents, and a translucent wing-like back drape.
